briefing.summary: As of Saturday August 8, 12:00 AM, satellite data for the Bald Range wildfire near Summerland, British Columbia shows 95 fire detections over 7.2 hours. An estimated 60 residents are cut off from all exits, with 24 road segments likely affected, including Princeton-Summerland Road, Garnet Valley Road, Bathville Road, Marsh Lane, and Bathville Road, Isintok-McNulty Forest Service Road. Estimated minimum drive times range from an average of 14.1 minutes to a longest sample of 21.2 minutes.
steps: Monitor local conditions and stay informed through official channels

Keep vehicle fuel tanks filled and ready if you decide to travel

pets: Prepare carriers, leashes, and food for your pets
